raw_segments.text: Here, am I going to Aunt Sarah's or not, my consubstantial father's voice?
Did you see anything of your artist brother Stephen lately?
No, sure he's not down in Strasbourg Terrace with his aunt Sally.
Couldn't he fly a bit higher than that, eh?
And in an intel us, Stephen, how is Uncle C?
Oh, weeping God, the things I married into, Du Bois up into Haloft, the drunken little
cost-drower and his brother, the cornet player, highly respectable gondoliers.
And skewed Walter, serving his father, no less.
Sir, yes, sir, no, sir, Jesus wept and no wonder by Christ.
